sn6.9:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tena kho pana samayena Kokāliko bhikkhu ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || Atha kho Tudu paccekabrahmā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappam Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Kokāliko bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā vehāsaṃ ṭhito Kokālikaṃ bhikkhum etad avoca || || Pasādehi Kokālika Sāriputtā-Moggallānesu cittaṃ || pesalā Sāriputta-Moggallānā ti || || Ko si tvam āvuso ti || || Ahaṃ Tudu paccekabrahmā ti || || Nanu tvam āvuso Bhagavatā anāgāmī byākato || atha kiñcarahi idhāgato || passa yāvañca te idam aparaddhan ti || ||
sn6.9:2.1: Purisassa hi jātassa || kuṭhārī jāyate mukhe || yāya chindati attānaṃ || bālo dubbhāsitaṃ bhaṇaṃ || ||
sn6.9:3.1: Yo nindiyaṃ pasaṃsati || tam vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyo || vicināti mukhena so kaliṃ || kalinā tena sukhaṃ na vindati || ||
sn6.9:4.1: Appamattako ayam kali || yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo || sabbassāpi sahāpi attanā || ayam eva mahantataro kali || yo Sugatesu manaṃ padosaye || ||
sn6.9:5.1: Sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānam || chattiṃsati pañca abbudāni || yam ariyagarahī nirayam upeti || vācaṃ mānañca paṇidhāya pāpakan ti || || .
